result.summary: No reportable visual defects. The page renders cleanly with consistent alignment, readable text, intact imagery, and working controls. The only clipped content is the partially visible last item of the horizontal carousels (category chips and the 'Fastest near you' row, including the truncated 'Trattoria Piccol' title) and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport, both of which are expected scroll behavior rather than defects.
